title: The 10 Best Programmable Slow Cookers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for programmable slow cookers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at programmable slow cookers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Crock-Pot SCCPVL610-S 6-Quart Cook and Carry Programmable
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart oval stoneware insert, Programmable digital timer, up to 20 hours, Auto-switch to keep-warm at cycle end.
strengths: Programmable timer with auto-switch to keep-warm, essential for working households
22,000+ Amazon ratings at 4.6 average, the highest-reviewed model in the category
3-clip gasket lid latches quickly, one-handed
Low temperature holds 195 to 205 degrees consistently over an 8-hour cook
limitations: Insert is not stovetop compatible
No digital temperature readout, only elapsed time
Timer increments in 30-minute steps only
Stoneware insert is heavy at roughly 4 pounds without food
features: Programmable digital timer, up to 20 hours
Auto-switch to keep-warm at cycle end
Low, High, and Keep Warm settings
